title: Citation audit over seeded draft and source excerpts
objective: Measure whether the citation-audit craftbook pairs claims to citations and reports supported, partial, unsupported, dead, and uncited claims.
prompt: In the `Citation Audit Eval` project, read only `source/draft.md` and `source/source-excerpts.md`, then write `tasks/eval/audit.md`. Audit exactly the four cited claims `Claim [A]` through `Claim [D]`, plus the uncited sentence about Finance receiving a weekly exception export. Do not add Claim [E], Claim [F], outside company metrics, or imagined source sections. Use verdicts Supported, Not-Supported, Source-Missing/Dead, and Uncited-Claim, with source quotes and concrete fixes.

setup.about: Self-contained eval project for citation-audit. Draft and source excerpts are seeded under workspace/source.
setup.missionObjectives: Audit every citation and uncited factual claim with strict verdicts, quotes from source excerpts, and concrete fixes.

files.content:
# Draft

Guided returns intake reduced median first response from 18 hours to 6 hours [A]. The pilot covered every SKU in the catalog [B]. Customers were 34% more satisfied after photo evidence was required [C]. Finance now receives a weekly exception export. Warehouse teams need barcode exception training before national rollout [D].

# Source excerpts

[A] Pilot dashboard: median first response improved from 18 hours to 6 hours for the 18 pilot SKUs.
[B] Rollout memo: March pilot covered 18 home-office accessory SKUs, not the full catalog.
[C] Source missing: no satisfaction survey was run during the pilot.
[D] Operations notes: warehouse teams need barcode exception training before national rollout.

success.summary: workspace/audit.md audits all seeded citations and uncited claims with rubric verdicts, source quotes, counts, and fixes.

checks.pattern: Claim \[E\]|Claim \[F\]|cost per return|50 concurrent|RESTful API|Q3|stress tests|Financial summary|System architecture|expansion of this report
checks.label: do not invent audit claims or source excerpts beyond the seeded draft
